projects.title: Classification of Breast Cancer Diagnosis
projects.desc: A machine learning project focused on analyzing and classifying breast cancer data. The dataset contains numerical features describing cell nuclei characteristics, which are used to identify patterns and classify tumors as benign or malignant using different classification algorithms.

projects.title: Minist Digits Recognizer in C
projects.desc: A handwritten digit recognition system built from scratch in C using the MNIST dataset. The project covers data loading, preprocessing, normalization, neural network training, evaluation, and testing using optimized matrix operations.
